comment: 闸门工具面期望（票据 03；票据 09 增 profiles 维度）。宿主换代时清单（gates/manifest.json）先变红 exit 2，重采基线时同步更新本文件。禁止整文件再生成：profiles.* 用 basedOn + changes 行级差异表达，每条 changes 必须带 direction 与 reason；测试会与 08 实测归档逐项对账。

changes.reason: dsh-base@0.1.7-rc.1 sets `tool-ralph disabled: true` by default (its cordis.patch.yml:444-447; upstream rationale: completion is a worker self-report, not an independent evaluation). The old expectation captured the 0.1.5 base, which left it enabled. No preset row re-enables it.
